Maya (Finance): Quick sync on the Billmesh pilot invoice we pulled this AM. A couple oddities in the CSV I want to flag.
Ashok (Procurement): What's odd?
Maya (Finance): Two rows for the same request_id with different SKUs: `gen_v2` vs `generation.api`. Looks like aliasing again.
Claire (EngOps): Confirmed. The SDK emits `generation` but Billmesh normalizes to `gen_v2` in one export and `generation.api` in another. Might be a joined export from two pipelines.
InvoiceBot: Automated check: invoice_2026-04-04.csv: 2x duplicate request_id entries, 1 missing pilot_account_id column.
Sam - Billmesh: Sorry — we rolled a mapping change yesterday and some legacy aliases slipped into the nightly export. We can regenerate the CSV with a canonical sku field and add `pilot_account_id`.
Maya (Finance): Can you also include an `applied_credit` column that shows how committed credits were consumed per line? We need line-level accounting for our ledger entries.
Tanya (Billmesh Billing): We can include `applied_credit` and `remaining_credit_balance` on the daily export. For pilots, credits are applied prorata by default, but we can accept a priority rule if you specify it in the SOW.
Ashok (Procurement): If we ask for priority consumption (embeddings first) as a pilot term, what concession does Billmesh need?
Sam - Billmesh: Usually just a one-time amendment to the SOW; we don't change billing engine wiring for pilots. We'll document the priority rule and enforce it in the reconciliation layer.
Claire (EngOps): Heads up: we'll run a small multi-threaded burst at 14:00 UTC to validate token attribution. Please don't process that test as production usage for billing until we align on mapping.
Maya (Finance): Also need to confirm timezone/aggregation window. Our accounting closes at 00:00 PST. Does Billmesh use UTC day boundaries?
Tanya (Billmesh Billing): Billmesh aggregates by UTC by default. We can provide a PST-shifted view for reconciliation export.
Maya (Finance): Great. One more: who is our escalation contact if invoice spikes appear? We need an SLA for investigation during the pilot window.
Sam - Billmesh: Primary contact is me (sam@billmesh.com). Billing lead Tanya (tanya@billmesh.com) is cc. For urgent invoicing issues call +1-415-555-0199.
Ashok (Procurement): Procurement asks to add a clause: "No auto-charge beyond pilot cap; any overage requires written PO." Can legal/finance confirm language?
Maya (Finance): Confirmed. Add clause and also add a migration credit line: up to 15% of pilot cap to cover mapping errors.
InvoiceBot: File uploaded: invoice_2026-04-04-v2.csv by Sam at 2026-04-04T09:17:10Z.
Maya (Finance): I'll validate the v2 file against our ledger and post discrepancies here. If all good, finance will sign-off on the pilot invoice queue. :thumbsup:
